data.title: Up to 30x More Work Per Watt: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Sets a New Efficiency Standard for AI Agents
data.description: New on-silicon performance data measured by NVIDIA using real-world agentic coding trajectories shows Vera Rubin NVL72 systems deliver 30x higher throughput per megawatt and 35x lower token costs than NVIDIA GB300 NVL72.
data.author: Shruti Koparkar
